import requests, collections, numpy as np, matplotlib.pyplot as plt
H={"User-Agent":"research-agent/1.0"}
accs={'HUMAN':'Q8IV36','MOUSE':'Q8R1F6','RAT':'D4A0C3','DICDI':'Q54JJ6','SCHPO_hid1':'O13776',
 'SCHPO_hid3':'Q9P7M6','SCHPO_hid2':'Q9HDV3','YEAST_ECM30':'Q06673','DANRE':'A0AC58J458',
 'DROME':'Q52KA6','CAEEL':'G5EG65','XENTR':'A0A8J0T003','CIOIN':'H2XV68','IXOSC':'A0ACM8DY32'}
S={n:"".join(requests.get(f"https://rest.uniprot.org/uniprotkb/{a}.fasta",headers=H,timeout=60).text.split("\n")[1:]) for n,a in accs.items()}
exec(compile(open('/dev/null').read() or 'pass','<x>','exec'))
B62="""A 4 -1 -2 -2 0 -1 -1 0 -2 -1 -1 -1 -1 -2 -1 1 0 -3 -2 0
R -1 5 0 -2 -3 1 0 -2 0 -3 -2 2 -1 -3 -2 -1 -1 -3 -2 -3
N -2 0 6 1 -3 0 0 0 1 -3 -3 0 -2 -3 -2 1 0 -4 -2 -3
D -2 -2 1 6 -3 0 2 -1 -1 -3 -4 -1 -3 -3 -1 0 -1 -4 -3 -3
C 0 -3 -3 -3 9 -3 -4 -3 -3 -1 -1 -3 -1 -2 -3 -1 -1 -2 -2 -1
Q -1 1 0 0 -3 5 2 -2 0 -3 -2 1 0 -3 -1 0 -1 -2 -1 -2
E -1 0 0 2 -4 2 5 -2 0 -3 -3 1 -2 -3 -1 0 -1 -3 -2 -2
G 0 -2 0 -1 -3 -2 -2 6 -2 -4 -4 -2 -3 -3 -2 0 -2 -2 -3 -3
H -2 0 1 -1 -3 0 0 -2 8 -3 -3 -1 -2 -1 -2 -1 -2 -2 2 -3
I -1 -3 -3 -3 -1 -3 -3 -4 -3 4 2 -3 1 0 -3 -2 -1 -3 -1 3
L -1 -2 -3 -4 -1 -2 -3 -4 -3 2 4 -2 2 0 -3 -2 -1 -2 -1 1
K -1 2 0 -1 -3 1 1 -2 -1 -3 -2 5 -1 -3 -1 0 -1 -3 -2 -2
M -1 -1 -2 -3 -1 0 -2 -3 -2 1 2 -1 5 0 -2 -1 -1 -1 -1 1
F -2 -3 -3 -3 -2 -3 -3 -3 -1 0 0 -3 0 6 -4 -2 -2 1 3 -1
P -1 -2 -2 -1 -3 -1 -1 -2 -2 -3 -3 -1 -2 -4 7 -1 -1 -4 -3 -2
S 1 -1 1 0 -1 0 0 0 -1 -2 -2 0 -1 -2 -1 4 1 -3 -2 -2
T 0 -1 0 -1 -1 -1 -1 -2 -2 -1 -1 -1 -1 -2 -1 1 5 -2 -2 0
W -3 -3 -4 -4 -2 -2 -3 -2 -2 -3 -2 -3 -1 1 -4 -3 -2 11 2 -3
Y -2 -2 -2 -3 -2 -1 -2 -3 2 -1 -1 -2 -1 3 -3 -2 -2 2 7 -1
V 0 -3 -3 -3 -1 -2 -2 -3 -3 3 1 -2 1 -1 -2 -2 0 -3 -1 4"""
AA="ARNDCQEGHILKMFPSTWYV"; sub={}
for line in B62.strip().split("\n"):
    p=line.split()
    for c,v in zip(AA,p[1:]): sub[(p[0],c)]=int(v)
sc=lambda a,b: sub.get((a,b),-4)
def nw(q,t,go=-11,ge=-1):
    n,m=len(q),len(t); NEG=-1e9
    Mp=[NEG]*(m+1); Xp=[NEG]*(m+1); Yp=[NEG]*(m+1); Mp[0]=0
    for j in range(1,m+1): Xp[j]=go+ge*(j-1)
    ptr=[]
    for i in range(1,n+1):
        M=[NEG]*(m+1); X=[NEG]*(m+1); Y=[NEG]*(m+1); Y[0]=go+ge*(i-1)
        row=bytearray(m+1); qi=q[i-1]
        for j in range(1,m+1):
            best=Mp[j-1]; st=0
            if Xp[j-1]>best: best=Xp[j-1]; st=1
            if Yp[j-1]>best: best=Yp[j-1]; st=2
            M[j]=best+sc(qi,t[j-1])
            a=M[j-1]+go; b=X[j-1]+ge; X[j]=a if a>=b else b
            c=Mp[j]+go; d=Yp[j]+ge; Y[j]=c if c>=d else d
            row[j]=st|(0 if a>=b else 4)|(0 if c>=d else 8)
        ptr.append(row); Mp,Xp,Yp=M,X,Y
    i,j=n,m; state=int(np.argmax([Mp[m],Xp[m],Yp[m]])); pairs=[]
    while i>0 and j>0:
        r=ptr[i-1][j]
        if state==0: pairs.append((i,j)); state=r&3; i-=1; j-=1
        elif state==1: state=0 if not (r&4) else 1; j-=1
        else: state=0 if not (r&8) else 2; i-=1
    return pairs
hum=S['HUMAN']; L=len(hum); cols=collections.defaultdict(list)
for n,s in S.items():
    if n!='HUMAN':
        for i,j in nw(hum,s): cols[i].append(s[j-1])
cons_sim=np.array([np.mean([sc(hum[i-1],c)>0 for c in cols[i]]) if cols[i] else 0 for i in range(1,L+1)])
cons_id=np.array([np.mean([c==hum[i-1] for c in cols[i]]) if cols[i] else 0 for i in range(1,L+1)])

pdb=requests.get("https://alphafold.ebi.ac.uk/files/AF-Q8IV36-F1-model_v6.pdb",headers=H,timeout=180).text
at=collections.defaultdict(list); plb={}
for l in pdb.splitlines():
    if l.startswith("ATOM"):
        n=int(l[22:26]); at[n].append((float(l[30:38]),float(l[38:46]),float(l[46:54])))
        if l[12:16].strip()=="CA": plb[n]=float(l[60:66])
N=max(at); plddt=np.array([plb[i] for i in range(1,N+1)])
cent=np.array([np.mean(at[i],0) for i in range(1,N+1)])
D=np.linalg.norm(cent[:,None]-cent[None,:],axis=-1); nbr=(D<10).sum(1)-1
exposed=nbr<=np.percentile(nbr,40)

def patches(mask,cut=8.0,minsz=6):
    idx=np.where(mask)[0]; par=list(range(len(idx)))
    def f(a):
        while par[a]!=a: par[a]=par[par[a]]; a=par[a]
        return a
    for a in range(len(idx)):
        for b in range(a+1,len(idx)):
            if D[idx[a],idx[b]]<cut:
                ra,rb=f(a),f(b)
                if ra!=rb: par[ra]=rb
    cl=collections.defaultdict(list)
    for a in range(len(idx)): cl[f(a)].append(idx[a]+1)
    return sorted([sorted(v) for v in cl.values() if len(v)>=minsz],key=lambda v:-len(v))

print("=== Conserved surface patches (exposed, pLDDT>70, similarity across 13 orthologs >= 0.85) ===")
m=exposed&(cons_sim>=0.85)&(plddt>70)
print("n residues:",m.sum())
for p in patches(m)[:10]:
    print(f"  size {len(p):>2} | Cterm frac {np.mean([r>=690 for r in p]):.2f} | {p}")
    print("        ", "".join(f"{hum[r-1]}{r} " for r in p))

print("\n=== Null comparison: patches among EXPOSED residues with LOW conservation (sim<=0.5) ===")
m2=exposed&(cons_sim<=0.5)&(plddt>70)
pl=patches(m2); print("n residues:",m2.sum(),"-> patches>=6:",len(pl),"largest:",len(pl[0]) if pl else 0)

# --- basic/membrane face analysis ---
basic=np.array([hum[i]in"KR" for i in range(L)]); acid=np.array([hum[i]in"DE" for i in range(L)])
nt=cent[1:20].mean(0)                      # myristoylated N-terminal helix centroid
dist_nt=np.linalg.norm(cent-nt,axis=1)
for cut in (20,25,30,40):
    near=(dist_nt<cut)&exposed; far=(dist_nt>=cut)&exposed
    q_near=(basic[near].sum()-acid[near].sum()); q_far=(basic[far].sum()-acid[far].sum())
    print(f"\nexposed residues within {cut} A of N-term helix: n={near.sum()}, net charge {q_near:+d} ({q_near/max(near.sum(),1):+.3f}/res)"
          f" | beyond: n={far.sum()}, net charge {q_far:+d} ({q_far/max(far.sum(),1):+.3f}/res)")
from scipy.stats import fisher_exact
near=(dist_nt<25)&exposed; far=(dist_nt>=25)&exposed
tab=[[basic[near].sum(),acid[near].sum()],[basic[far].sum(),acid[far].sum()]]
odds,p=fisher_exact(tab)
print(f"\nFisher exact, basic vs acidic exposed residues near (<25A) vs far from the myristoyl anchor: table={tab} OR={odds:.2f} p={p:.3g}")
print("exposed K/R within 25 A of N-term anchor:", [f"{hum[i]}{i+1}" for i in np.where(near&basic)[0]])

fig,ax=plt.subplots(1,2,figsize=(12,5))
ax[0].scatter(dist_nt[exposed],cons_sim[exposed],s=8,c=np.where(basic[exposed],"#c0392b",np.where(acid[exposed],"#2980b9","#bbb")))
ax[0].set_xlabel("distance from myristoylated N-terminal helix (A)"); ax[0].set_ylabel("ortholog similarity")
ax[0].set_title("Exposed residues: red = Lys/Arg, blue = Asp/Glu")
bins=np.arange(0,70,7.5); mid=(bins[:-1]+bins[1:])/2
net=[ (basic[(dist_nt>=a)&(dist_nt<b)&exposed].sum()-acid[(dist_nt>=a)&(dist_nt<b)&exposed].sum())/max(((dist_nt>=a)&(dist_nt<b)&exposed).sum(),1) for a,b in zip(bins[:-1],bins[1:])]
ax[1].bar(mid,net,width=6,color=["#c0392b" if v>0 else "#2980b9" for v in net])
ax[1].axhline(0,c="k",lw=0.8); ax[1].set_xlabel("distance from myristoyl anchor (A)")
ax[1].set_ylabel("net charge per exposed residue")
ax[1].set_title("Surface charge gradient away from the membrane anchor")
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
